description: RESUME tests reinforced-concrete frames at 1:3 scale with an external retrofit combining timber, aluminium and cork insulation. One specimen is tested before and after strengthening; another is strengthened before testing. Acceleration, displacement and strain records are accompanied by input motions, instrumentation drawings, photographs and videos for model validation. The dataset is provided by IZIIS, Skopje through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2025. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED labels the resource CC BY 4.0, while DOI or repository metadata states CC-BY-NC-4.0. Applicable licence terms remain unresolved. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
